name: Lilia Iustitia
original_name: リリア・ユースティティア
source:
[b]Class:[/b] Warrior
[b]Personality:[/b] Earnest and Serious

An exceptionally diligent and disciplined succubus with a strong sense of responsibility.

Lilia makes up for her lack of confidence through relentless effort and determination. Although she possesses the instincts of a succubus, she's easily embarrassed by her own desires and often struggles to come to terms with them. She naturally takes charge as the party's leader, but her sincerity often causes her plans to backfire.

She is the second daughter of the prestigious House Justitia, a family of renowned warriors. Despite being a succubus, she dreams of becoming someone who can stand proudly on the battlefield through her own strength.

She enjoys black tea, studying military strategy, and practicing sword dance in the mornings.

[b]Hopeless Trait:[/b] [i]Unconscious Aphrodisiac Pheromones (Wide-Area Type)[/i]
Whenever the excitement or tension of battle rises, Lilia unintentionally releases powerful aphrodisiac pheromones.
Completely beyond her control, they affect everyone nearby—friend and foe alike—turning the battlefield into utter chaos. While she's doing her absolute best to fight with complete seriousness, the end is always a spectacular disaster.

[b]Secret Memo[/b]: [i]Lilia is unusually strict, proper, and straight-laced for a succubus. But as everyone knows... it's always the ones with the strongest self-control who become the most dangerous once they finally lose it...?[/i]

[b][i]"Please...! I beg of you...! If you truly wish to help me... then please fill my tight virgin pussy with every last drop of your extraordinarily concentrated life essence, Instructor Glenn...!" [/i]
